task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [4, 10, 7, 9, 6], weights [1, 3, 4, 3, 5], capacity 13) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler.
